content.short: SuperRare is an NFT marketplace for collecting and trading unique, single-edition digital artworks.
content.description: SuperRare is an NFT marketplace founded in 2017. The platform enables users to collect, view, and participate in live auctions for digital artworks. Developers and community members can contribute through the SuperRare DAO, which supports editing and curation of the platform. Each artwork is authentically created by artists within the network and tokenized as a crypto-collectible digital item that users can own, trade, and display in their collections.
